components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#0b6fb8; color:#fff; border:1px solid #0b6fb8; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 12px; min-height:32px; font:600 13.5px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#085a96; border-color:#085a96; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6fb8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { background:#fff; color:#22272c; border:1px solid #c4cbd2; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 12px; min-height:32px; font:500 13.5px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#f1f4f7; border-color:#aab3bc; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6fb8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-fld { display:grid; gap:4px; font:600 12.5px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color:#5b636c; width:220px; } .ds-input { border:1px solid #c4cbd2; border-radius:4px; padding:6px 9px; min-height:34px; font:14px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color:#22272c; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#9aa5af; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#0b6fb8; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(11,111,184,.18); }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail"><button aria-current="page"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><rect x="7" y="3" width="10" height="18" rx="1.5"/><path d="M7 8h10M7 13h10M7 17h10"/></svg>Log</button><button><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16M9 6v12"/></svg>Data</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail { width:72px; display:grid; gap:2px; padding:8px 6px; background:#fff; border-right:1px solid #d6dbe0; } .ds-rail button { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:3px; padding:8px 2px 7px; border:0; background:none; border-radius:6px; color:#5b636c; font:600 11px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-rail svg { width:22px; height:22px; } .ds-rail button:hover { background:#f1f4f7; color:#22272c; } .ds-rail [aria-current=page] { background:#e6f1fa; color:#085a96; }

components.name: Borehole Row
components.description: Project borehole list row with status dot.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; gap:1px 10px; align-items:center; width:240px; padding:8px 10px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:none; font:14px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color:#22272c; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-row i { grid-row:1/span 2; width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#c9a227; } .ds-row em { font-style:normal; color:#1676bd; font-size:12px; } .ds-row small { grid-column:2/-1; color:#5b636c; font-size:12px; } .ds-row:hover { background:#f1f4f7; } .ds-row.on { background:#e6f1fa; } .ds-row.on b { color:#085a96; }

components.css: .ds-panel { width:320px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #d6dbe0; border-radius:8px; font:14px 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color:#22272c; } .ds-panel header { padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #eceef1; font-weight:600; font-size:15px; } .ds-panel div { padding:14px 16px; color:#5b636c; }

narrative.overview:
The app looks and behaves like the best engineering field-data software (Bentley OpenGround, Esri ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123), played straight and finished to their level. A dark slate header, a narrow navigation rail, a panel listing the project's boreholes, the work area, and a properties panel from the right.

The look is calm and neutral; colour does jobs only: action blue for action and selection, groundwater blue, soil colours and status colours. Panels are border-defined; only floating layers cast shadows.

Office density and field density of the same components; light only.
keyCharacteristics: Dark slate header, light rail and panels, cool grey canvas.
One action blue; every other colour encodes data or status.
Border-defined panels with 8px corners; shadows only on floating layers.
Tabular, monospaced measurements on logs and plots.
Office and field densities of the same parts.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Action blue marks the primary action, focus and the current selection only; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Data Colour Rule
rules.body: Every other saturated colour means water, soil or status, and never appears without its symbol or word.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Numbers that are measured use tabular figures; on drawings they use the mono face.

rules.name: The Declare-Once Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a border or a shadow, never both; resting panels get the border.

dos: Do keep panels white with a 1px Border (#d6dbe0) on the Canvas (#f3f4f6).
Do keep Action Blue (#0b6fb8) for the primary action, focus and selection.
Do give field controls at least 44px and step actions 52 to 56px.
Do pair every data colour with its symbol, pattern or word.
Do theme selection, focus rings, scrollbars and checkboxes from the palette.
donts: Don't add a dark theme; light only.
Don't put shadows on resting panels or combine a border with a wide shadow.
Don't mark selection with a thick coloured edge; use the Selection fill.
Don't use eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't go below 11px for on-screen text.
